title: evacuation-first-priming-orchestrator-for-vpc-runtime-rollouts
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build an orchestration component and accompanying IaC hooks that performs "evacuation-first" zero-downtime rollouts for Private (VPC) data plane/runtime upgrades. The orchestrator must safely drain traffic from target instances, snapshot and evacuate KV cache state, run bounded priming/warmup workflows against a small set of warm replicas, and only shift live traffic once health quorum and correctness checks pass. The flow must include clear fast rollback paths (snapshot restore + slot reattach) and Terraform plan-time gating so operators can reason about capacity changes before applying upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Can perform a staged rollout across a tenant slice without dropping active streams or producing stale responses
Automated rollback restores previous runtime within 5 minutes of rollback trigger in >95% of simulated failures
P99 generation latency does not exceed baseline by more than 20% during normal rollouts; error rate stays <0.1%
Priming job warms KV prefixes for top-1000 hot keys within configured warm window and reduces cold-miss rate by at least 60% in post-rollout traffic
Terraform plan shows explicit capacity and slot-affinity changes and blocks apply when a plan would violate configured safety thresholds
End-to-end integration test (synthetic + chaos) passes in CI with observable artifacts (PR, dashboard, logs)
implementation_notes: Orchestrator runs as a controller in customer control-plane and can be toggled via runtime.rollout.enabled flag
Evacuation step: issue graceful drain request, snapshot in-memory KV state to S3-like tenant store, then mark node as ReadOnly for new priming traffic
Priming step: spawn a configurable priming job pool that replays a sampled prefix workload against new nodes to populate KV and prefix caches
Health gating: combine synthetic probes, p99 latency guard, and correctness checks (consistency checksum on critical prefixes) into a quorum function before promotion
Rollback: snapshot last-known-good state created pre-upgrade; rollback flow must support fast mount and slot reattach with traffic cutover automation
Terraform hooks: add plan-time validator module (terraform module path: modules/vpc/rollout_guard) that calculates potential impact and emits a human-readable gating report
Metrics/telemetry: instrument evacuation duration, priming success ratio, snapshot size/duration, rollback recovery time, and plan-time gating warnings
testing_plan: Unit tests for controller primitives (drain, snapshot, priming job lifecycle)
Integration tests in staging that run full upgrade + rollback across 3 tenant slices
Load test with realistic token-per-second and long-lived stream mixes to validate no request loss
Chaos run: kill instance mid-priming to validate idempotent resume and safe rollback
Terraform plan/time sandbox runs to validate gating logic and operator messages
Pre-release canary for 5% of new customer slices with extra logging for first 48 hours
risks: Large snapshot sizes could delay promotion and cause temporary capacity pressure
Priming can generate additional cost and load; must be rate-limited per-tenant
Inconsistent KV schema changes across runtime versions may require compatibility transforms
Terraform gating must be accurate or operators will bypass it, reducing safety guarantees
